mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% (FEDFUNDS) indicates sustained accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and increasing risk appetite, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 230 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.2%, the market interprets this as accommodative policy supporting growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting CPIAUCSL>230 and FEDFUNDS<0.2, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle recovery phases, housing starts (HOUST) above 900 thousand units signal strengthening consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 900 during early-cycle recovery, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 98 indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 98, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 400,000 million dollars indicate strong consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 400,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 135,000 thousand and unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 7.6%, the labor market strengthening boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting PAYEMS>135000 and UNRATE<7.6, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-2008 recovery phase, a federal funds rate below 0.2% (FEDFUNDS) signals sustained accommodative policy supporting asset prices, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during post-2008 recovery when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
